items.title: Anemic offense sinks Falcons in I-75 shutout
items.summary: BGSU entered their rivalry game with Toledo as one of the worst offenses in the MAC – 11th out of 13 teams in touchdowns scored (23), points scored (193) and yards per game (292.5).  They continued those struggles against the Rockets. items.title: Rockets dominate Falcons in Battle of I-75 19-0 in first shutout of Eddie George era
items.summary: Bowling Green (3-8, 3-4) fell in a lopsided loss to their rivals, the Toledo Rockets (9-2, 6-1), in a scoreless 19-0 final in the 91st edition of the Battle of I-75.   The 19-0 final is the first shutout in the rivalry since the Falcons won 21-0 in 1985. items.title: Falcons Fall, 19-0, to Rockets Friday Night
items.summary: The Rockets picked up their second victory in the last five series meetings, and the game was Toledo's first win over the Falcons in the Glass Bowl in six years.

items.title: Around the MAC: Little Fish, Big Pond
items.summary: The Mid-American Conference (MAC) has long operated in the shadow of college football’s powerhouses. No MAC team has ever made the College Football Playoff (CFP), nor any national championship prior to the CFP. items.title: Friday Night Lights: Falcons Set Eyes On Rival Rockets For National TV Road Game
BGSU-UMass Football Moved Back To 3:30 p.m. Kickoff Time
items.summary: BOWLING GREEN, Ohio - Bowling Green State University Athletics in partnership with the Mid-American Conference has announced an adjustment to the kickoff time for the football game between Bowling Green and UMass. The Falcons and Minutemen will now start at 3:30 p.m. on Saturday, Nov. 28 with the game being broadcast on ESPN+.

items.title: Myles Bradley, Ryan Kingston Named MAC Players of the Week
items.summary: CLEVELAND, Ohio - The Mid American Conference announced the football players of the week Monday morning (Nov. 16). Of those named, Bowling Green's Myles Bradley earned the MAC Defensive Player of the Week honor and Ryan Kingston was named the MAC Special Teams Player of the Week. items.title: Falcons Down Flashes, 33-28, in Tuesday-Night Thriller
items.summary: Nakai Amachree's 48-yard touchdown run with 1:51 left in the fourth quarter lifted the Bowling Green State University football team to a 33-28 win over Kent State University Tuesday night (Nov. 10), in Mid-American Conference action at Doyt L. Perry Stadium.
